title: Tracing basics
body: A trace is the complete record of one agent run, identified by a single trace ID. Inside it, a span is one timed operation with a name, a start and end timestamp, a parent, and a bag of key-value attributes.

title: Spans form a tree
body: Spans nest via parent references, so a trace forms a tree whose structure encodes causality: which tool result was available when which decision was made. The model comes from Dapper (Sigelman et al., 2010).

title: The agent loop
body: An agent loop alternates a model decision with a tool execution until a stop condition fires. Without a step budget, a derailed loop runs until some external cap ends it.
